prompt: As of August 2024, the Atlanta Braves beat the Houston Astros the last time they won the World Series. How many years before this did Jackie Robinson join the Brooklyn Dodgers?
answer:
Jackie Robinson joined the Brooklyn Dodgers in **1947**. The Braves last won the World Series in **2021**, so this was **74 years later**.

Therefore, Jackie Robinson joined the Dodgers **74 years before** the Braves’ 2021 World Series victory.
